passages.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
This happened in the first year of his reign.
The LORD had spoken a word through Jeremiah.
The LORD wanted to fulfill His word.
The LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia.
Cyrus made a proclamation throughout his whole kingdom.
He also wrote it down.
This is what Cyrus, king of Persia, said:
The LORD is the God of heaven.
The LORD has given me all the kingdoms of the earth.
The LORD has appointed me to build a house for Him.
This house will be in Jerusalem, in Judah.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑ה הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ כֹּ֣רֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־ קוֹל֙ בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־ בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֗ר כֹּ֚רֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס כֹּ֚ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ נָ֣תַן לִ֔י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֽוּא־ פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Whoever among you belongs to His people, may his God be with him, and may he go to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel; He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
Cyrus spoke to the people of Israel.
He said, “Whoever among you belongs to God’s people, listen.”
May your God be with you.
Go up to Jerusalem in Judah.
Build the house of the LORD there.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
passages.original: מִֽי־ בָכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־ עַמּ֗וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְיַ֕עַל לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּיהוּדָ֑ה וְיִ֗בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And let every survivor, wherever he lives, be assisted by the men of that region with silver, gold, goods, and livestock, along with a freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
God gave Cyrus authority over many kingdoms.
God told Cyrus to build a house for Him in Jerusalem.
Cyrus made a proclamation to all his kingdom.
He said, “Let every survivor help those who are going to Jerusalem.
Wherever a survivor lives, the people of that place must help him.
They must give him silver.
They must give him gold.
They must give him goods.
They must give him livestock.
They must also give a freewill offering.
This offering is for the house of God in Jerusalem.”
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַנִּשְׁאָ֗ר מִֽכָּל־ הַמְּקֹמוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ה֣וּא גָֽר־ שָׁם֒ יְנַשְּׂא֙וּהוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מְקֹמ֔וֹ בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב וּבִרְכ֣וּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָ֑ה עִם־ הַ֨נְּדָבָ֔ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: So the family heads of Judah and Benjamin, along with the priests and Levites—everyone whose spirit God had stirred—prepared to go up and rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of the families of Judah and Benjamin stood up.
The priests stood up.
The Levites stood up.
God had stirred their spirits.
They prepared to go to Jerusalem.
They planned to rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיָּק֜וּמוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֗וֹת לִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְכֹ֨ל הֵעִ֤יר הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ רוּח֔וֹ לַעֲל֣וֹת לִבְנ֔וֹת אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And all their neighbors supported them with articles of silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with valuables, in addition to all their freewill offerings.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah and Benjamin prepared to return to Jerusalem.
Their neighbors lived around them.
These neighbors gave them help.
They gave them articles made of silver.
They gave them articles made of gold.
They gave them goods.
They gave them livestock.
They gave them valuable things.
They gave these gifts freely.
They gave these gifts in addition to all the freewill offerings.
passages.original: וְכָל־ סְבִיבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ חִזְּק֣וּ בִֽידֵיהֶ֔ם בִּכְלֵי־ כֶ֧סֶף בַּזָּהָ֛ב בָּרְכ֥וּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבַמִּגְדָּנ֑וֹת לְבַ֖ד עַל־ כָּל־ הִתְנַדֵּֽב׃ס

passages.text: King Cyrus also brought out the articles belonging to the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and placed in the temple of his gods.
passages.sermon:
King Cyrus was the king of Persia.
King Cyrus brought out the articles from the house of the LORD.
These articles belonged to the temple in Jerusalem.
Nebuchadnezzar had taken these articles from Jerusalem.
Nebuchadnezzar had put them in the temple of his gods.
King Cyrus brought these articles out.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ כּ֔וֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִ֖יא אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֤יא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
Cyrus gave the articles to Mithredath.
Mithredath was the treasurer.
Mithredath counted the articles.
Mithredath gave the articles to Sheshbazzar.
Sheshbazzar was the prince of Judah.
passages.original: וַיּֽוֹצִיאֵ֗ם כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס עַל־ יַ֖ד מִתְרְדָ֣ת הַגִּזְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּסְפְּרֵם֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֔ר הַנָּשִׂ֖יא לִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: This was the inventory: 30 gold dishes, 1,000 silver dishes, 29 silver utensils, 30 gold bowls, 410 matching silver bowls, and 1,000 other articles.
passages.sermon:
This is the inventory of the articles.
There were 30 gold dishes.
There were 1,000 silver dishes.
There were 29 silver utensils.
There were 30 gold bowls.
There were 410 matching silver bowls.
There were 1,000 other articles.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה מִסְפָּרָ֑ם אֲגַרְטְלֵ֨י זָהָ֜ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֗ים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ אָ֔לֶף מַחֲלָפִ֖ים תִּשְׁעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס כְּפוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֔ים כְּפ֤וֹרֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ מִשְׁנִ֔ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַעֲשָׂרָ֑ה כֵּלִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: In all, there were 5,400 gold and silver articles. Sheshbazzar brought all these along when the exiles went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Sheshbazzar was the leader of the returning exiles from Babylon.
The exiles left Babylon and traveled to Jerusalem.
They brought many valuable items with them.
There were 5,400 articles made of gold and silver.
Sheshbazzar brought all these gold and silver articles with the exiles to Jerusalem.
passages.original: כָּל־ כֵּלִים֙ לַזָּהָ֣ב וְלַכֶּ֔סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת הַכֹּ֞ל הֶעֱלָ֣ה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֗ר עִ֚ם הֵעָל֣וֹת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
